title: NASA Asteroid 2018 RC WARNING: Newly discovered asteroid to skim Earth on SUNDAY
excerpt: THE recently discovered Asteroid 2018 RC is heading towards us this weekend for a near-Earth approach, NASA has revealed. By SEBASTIAN KETTLEY PUBLISHED: 11:52, Thu, Sep 6, 2018 | UPDATED: 12:04, Thu, Sep 6, 2018
body:
THE recently discovered Asteroid 2018 RC is heading towards us this weekend for a near-Earth approach, NASA has revealed.
By SEBASTIAN KETTLEY
